title: Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   C. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   D. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   D. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   D. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   D. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on good Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Greetings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Knowledge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Gratitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
